correctness.rationale: Narasimhan-Seshadri identifies stable determinant-trivial bundles with irreducible unitary representations. Both binary polyhedral images are self-normalizing SU(2) subgroups (rotational normalizers S4 and A5), so each surjection orbit has |G|/2 representatives. A separately authored exact finite group implementation independently enumerated SL2(F5) and quaternionic 2O multiplication, all 76 and 35 subgroups and commutator distributions. It obtains genus-two Hom 3309120 and 335616, Epi 2764800 and 207360, and quotient 46080 and 8640. Formula holds for every complex genus-two curve through pi1 topological invariance.
residual_risks: The SU(2) normalizer and determinant-trivial identification are mathematical (not executable) steps; verified from classification and Narasimhan-Seshadri.
